reviewType: Independent read-only security/QA design re-review R1; not a lifecycle or implementation QA verdict
summary: All four original PUB-001..004 security/QA gaps are addressed by concrete D/C production contracts. One actual persisted-plan shape mismatch remains: C4 omits server-issued needs[].bindingId while requiring the exact V32 accepted-plan hash. Correct that narrow contract before PO; the rest of the revised security architecture is acceptable subject to the retained implementation/test conditions.

ownership.newContractCorrectionNeedsNoMandatoryNew: Separate accepted-plan type can be hosted in already reserved publication contracts/basis validators; raw model schema remains frozen.

originalFindingDisposition.assessment: Concrete EvidenceRepository capture occurs in storePreparation while the original sanitized observation is current and in the same transaction; admission facts join atomically to the selected proof/obligation. Immutable bounded tables, missing-history refusal, multipage/restart tests and a basis independent of lowerer output resolve the original retention/equivalence gap. PUB-R1-001 is the remaining accepted-plan serialization correction.

Separate ReceiptReadGrant/READ_PUBLISHED_RECEIPT uses actual uncached Core, same original/caller principal and current canRead, independent of expired worker/session/publication grant/current source/head. Stored request identity prevents mismatch; current readiness is separated from immutable historical publication. This resolves the original authority/deadline contradiction.

Concrete006 ObservedReplayAuthorization issues a noncredential execution/preallocated-attempt/revision/scope/profile/policy/account-bound grant after fresh Core canExecute; expiry is at most 30 seconds until admission. Acceptance/dispatch/admission compare immutable binding and expiry/current local revocation, with no cached/provisional/background substitute or unattended cookie refresh. The stated possible30-second Core revocation lag is honest bounded authority, not an instantaneous-revocation claim. Observed schedules fail closed; only account connectivity remains007.

New result3/session-view3 selected by immutable publication base expose UUID revisionId plus revisionDigest from the real receipt/projector and separate currentReadiness. Original result2 hash-shaped readyRevisionId remains unchanged.008 automatic finalize/poll/reconnect and first-run recording boundary is explicit; no fake video/timings/ordinary replay row is introduced.

blockers.finding: C4 defines AcceptedTranslationPlan as the closed v2/source-selection schema with the sole extension obligations[].obligationId. Actual OBS-005 plans additionally contain needs[].bindingId: GuidedDependencyPlanner.allocate writes the server-issued bridge binding ID into every need, and bootstrap persists that enriched plan as the accepted V32 head. The referenced source-selection need object is closed and has no bindingId. Therefore the proposed exact basis type rejects every real implicit-reference plan, or forces stripping an original field and breaking the promised H(actual persisted translationPlan)=translationHash join.
blockers.required_correction: Define the exact accepted-need shape with the server-issued bindingId in addition to needId/producerStepId/consumers. For final publication require its exact one-to-one correspondence to the authoritative allocation for the same need and the original read/consumer graph. Preserve the full persisted accepted-plan bytes/canonical hash; do not remove bindingId to fit the source-model schema or allow model-issued allocation authority. Keep the raw model source-selection schema unchanged. Update C4 and its fixtures/required evidence; existing reserved publication contract implementation files can host the separate accepted-plan type.
required_oracles: Use the actual closed005 implicit-reference flow to FINALIZING, read the production persisted V32 plan with needs[].bindingId, and accept it unchanged into ValidationBasis; Node must reproduce its stored translationHash.

Keep the malicious plan schema-valid but replace needs[].bindingId with another existing allocation, mismatch need/producer/consumer association, or recompute its local translationHash. Independent basis/allocation/admission joins refuse publication.
Missing bindingId for an allocated required need refuses; a no-needs plan remains valid. Raw model SOURCE_PLAN responses still cannot allocate binding IDs.
blockers.scope: A concrete design/production-shape inconsistency, not a demand to implement006 before PO or to reopen005.

mandatoryConditions.condition: Original evidence capture and independent derivation must use exact immutable V32/bridge records including accepted need binding IDs. Validate the original metadata ACK against its original snapshot; do not compare it to later materialization revisions or treat stale unassociated preparations as live authority.
oracles: Multipage and same-step observations overwritten before finalization still produce exact retained guards after restart.
Mutate schema-valid target/operation/read/guard/input/edge facts and recompute artifact-local hashes: original basis binding must still reject them.

mandatoryConditions.condition: Implement D1/D4/D5/D6 parent locks, epoch/ABA guards, session-wide three charged validation claims, reciprocal deferred origin/receipt FKs, both V19 capability orders, source/authoring/head/fence/deadline rechecks and compile_request_id clearing. Final success is atomic; expected conflict is a fresh guarded transition that cannot overwrite a winning receipt/cancel.
oracles: Real PostgreSQL direct-SQL missing/null/cross-scope/immutability tests, every rollback point, old/new compile races and two-session one-winner publication.

During validation, allow a normal same-owner lease renewal to be distinguished from owner/fence loss; explicitly bind the captured authority deadline versus current live lease. Renewal must not silently extend a committed claim or cause otherwise valid finalization to burn all claims solely through volatile snapshot hashing.
Across keys/restarts, at most three actual validator sends; stale result/claim/lease/snapshot cannot be applied; validated unchanged proof reuses without another call.

mandatoryConditions.condition: Run actual normal recorded-child replay with exact job/admission/profile/IPC joins, trusted policy and scoped account SPI. Values originate in the fresh child-local map; no historical node/admission rights, source/code/artifact, captured value or account handle enters inappropriate diagnostics or persistence. Preserve actual fixed isolated fill/select semantics and native pointer/key guards.
oracles: One learning submit; zero finalize navigation/read/mutation and both gateways zero; two later distinct unpredictable values reach independent application receipts with identical plan/artifact/policy hashes.

Delayed/lost account consume/apply, origin/type/policy/target replacement, duplicate/hidden locator, wrong graph/slot/attempt/handle, cancellation and context loss refuse without repeating setup/effects; video remains a separate authorized real replay channel.

mandatoryConditions.condition: Use actual bean/route matrix for independent publication/replay flags, durable result-contract selection and explicit observed schedule refusal. Preserve old activation and legacy runtime paths. Execution Profile excludes model/provider/prompt/API pins; those remain immutable audit provenance, not current replay requirements.
oracles: All four flag combinations including historical receipt reads while both flags are off, existing005 starts without a base, queued artifact2 refusal when replay is disabled and no legacy/model fallback.
Actual scheduler after publication retains activation/revision/enablement and refuses mismatch; observed attempts cannot obtain a provisional grant.
Benign historical prompt/provider/API changes do not cause re-learning or gateway calls for an otherwise compatible saved replay; actual execution/profile revocation or incompatible image refuses.

mandatoryConditions.condition: Production Core/source/publisher/validator/readiness/dispatcher/admission/child wiring must be exercised; only account connectivity is controlled. Preserve all original evidence and ordinary RUN/same-principal auto-accept; no hash-echo validator, fabricated confirmed revision or simulated first-run recording satisfies QA.
oracles: Raw SDK/model counters demonstrate no calls during finalization and both replays; typed unsafe mutations falsify independent expected operations/guards/edges.
Store exact source/build/worker/pins, distinguish controlled versus live evidence and unavailable services, retain old result2 compatibility and no new 007/008/009/010 implementation requirement.

mandatoryConditions.condition: The concrete result3/receipt controller must enter the separate receipt-read path before existing active-session/account/canExecute guards can veto historical access. Fresh Core canRead and original principal remain mandatory.
oracles: After expiry and head/source edits, an original principal who retains canRead but loses canExecute reads the historical receipt without validator/browser/new publication; current readiness is false when appropriate.
A stale cached owner identity cannot override current Core denial/changed principal; unavailable Core or absent cookie refuses without persistence/logging of credentials.

mandatoryConditions.condition: Keep the explicitly documented 30-second admission window and no unattended extension. The account ABI is a fixed trusted registry with sensitive ephemeral handles and at-most-once consumed/prepared/applied/disposed state. No account/Core/validator I/O holds DB locks.
oracles: Revocation before mint refuses; a later Core-only revocation is tested against the documented bounded lag, not misrepresented as instantaneous. Queue/lock/transport delay cannot renew grant expiry.

Local cancel, policy/catalog replacement and account isCurrent/consume rejection prevent a new admission; wrong execution/attempt/revision/scope grant/handle swaps refuse. After admission existing fixed run deadlines/cancellation remain authoritative.
